proposedNotice: Proposed launch policy — prototype assumption. Please confirm with RAVAAN before relying on it.

sections.heading: Delivery charges
list: Free delivery on orders above PKR 5,000.

sections.heading: Good to know
text: We aim to deliver orders within the estimated delivery window. Delivery times may vary depending on the destination, courier operations and order processing.
Once your order has been processed, you can contact us on WhatsApp for an update.
These are prototype assumptions and must be confirmed with the actual courier arrangement before public launch.

sections.heading: Payment
text: Proposed initial payment method: Cash on Delivery (COD). The customer pays the order amount to the courier upon delivery.

sections.heading: Our approach
text: We want you to feel confident about your RAVAAN purchase. If your item has a sizing issue or arrives with a problem, contact our support team within 7 days of delivery.

sections.heading: Proposed terms
list: Customers may request an exchange within 7 days of receiving their order.
Items must be unused, unworn, unwashed and in their original condition.
Original tags and packaging should be retained.
Exchange requests must be submitted through WhatsApp.
Sale items may be excluded from exchange, subject to the final published policy.
Refunds are not automatically offered under this proposed exchange-only policy.

sections.heading: Start an exchange
text: Message us on WhatsApp with your order details and we will guide you through the process.

sections.heading: Cancelling an order
text: Order cancellation requests should be submitted as soon as possible through WhatsApp. Orders that have already been dispatched may not be eligible for cancellation.

sections.heading: Your information
text: RAVAAN respects your privacy. Information provided during checkout, including your name, phone number and delivery address, is used to process and coordinate your order.
We do not intentionally request unnecessary personal information through our website.
Order details may be shared with relevant delivery service providers when necessary to fulfil an order.
Customers may contact RAVAAN through WhatsApp regarding questions about their submitted order information.

sections.heading: On this device
text: Your shopping bag is stored in your browser (localStorage) so it is still there when you return. It is not sent anywhere until you choose to continue to WhatsApp.
